name: rl0ve-agent-skills
description: Portable agent skills and routing plugins: model and UI routers, natural writing, walkthrough video, capability storyboards, decks, assessment guides, and visual version review.

metadata.description: Portable agent skills and routing plugins: model and UI routers, natural writing, walkthrough video, capability storyboards, decks, assessment guides, and visual version review.

plugins.name: ui-router
plugins.description: Design routing, interactive-world choices, visual resources, and verified interactions

plugins.name: natural-writing
plugins.description: Diagnose, edit, rewrite, or draft natural prose while preserving facts, formatting, intent, register, and author voice.

plugins.name: work-router
plugins.description: Routes substantial agent work to the leanest reliable parent or subagent configuration on task shape, ambiguity, risk, latency, and token use. Carries a route table for Claude Code and one for Codex. Includes capability discovery and scoped deduplication of installed skills.

plugins.name: capability-storyboard
plugins.description: Build a capability-first, multi-tool HTML storyboard for a keynote, demo walkthrough, or narrative product doc. Ships a working template and a finished nine-scene example board to lift components from.

plugins.name: deck-builder
plugins.description: Build and quality-check PowerPoint decks on top of any corporate template. Reads the template and generates a brand pack, so the palette, grid, layouts, and logo zone are configuration rather than code.

plugins.name: ui-walkthrough-video
plugins.description: Real UI walkthroughs with optional HyperFrames composition, measured speech cues and reusable voice narration.

plugins.name: visual-version-review
plugins.description: Compare implemented UI versions, branches and previews in one source-labeled HTML review with matched captures, globe and map distinctions, and element-level decisions.

plugins.name: clear-assessment-guides
plugins.description: Source-backed assessments, practical guides, annotated issue triage, and interactive HTML review with comments and decisions. Product- and vendor-neutral.
